messages:
tessa: opening a tiny PR to add 'scale guardrails' examples + SDK snippets for Dedicated capacity onboarding. want a quick sanity-check on SLA phrasing and isolation label examples before i merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/456
mike: quick Q — include both YAML + Python SDK snippets or just link to the SDK reference?
olivia: include both. short YAML + a 3-line python example is helpful. also pls avoid 'preemption' as a single word without clarifying reserved-pool semantics.
docs-bot: New PR created by tessa: docs/pull/456 — reviewers requested: @mike @olivia
mike: nit: add one-sentence definition of "isolation labels" at top of section. small callout is enough.
tessa: added callout in my head, will push. adding note about fallback to cheaper model variant under capacity constraints.
sre-ryan: ops POV: add explicit line about graceful SLO degradation — e.g., "under sustained capacity pressure, latency SLOs may degrade; fallback policies and notifications are triggered (console + webhook)." mention auto-rollback for canary misconfigs too.
tessa: writing that now. also adding an ops snippet about healthchecks + hysteresis (cooldown + min_replicas) to avoid thrash.
olivia: sample YAML you can include (very small):
```
# dedicated/provisioning/sample-capacity.yaml
capacity:
  name: my-tenant-pool
  reserved_gpus: 8
  isolation_labels: ["prod", "nl-1"]
  scale_policy:
    target_utilization: 0.65
    cooldown_seconds: 300
    min_replicas: 2
    burst_enabled: true
```
mike: and a short python snippet for SDK docs (match SDK v0.8 names):
```
from redwood import DedicatedClient
c = DedicatedClient()
resp = c.create_capacity(name="my-tenant-pool", gpus=8, isolation_labels=["prod","nl-1"])
```
olivia: i'll add a tiny table distinguishing "best-effort eviction" vs "hard eviction" wording and a one-line explanation. legal flagged absolute phrases like "will be" — change to "aims to" / "targets".
tessa: good call. will reword SLA section to be conservative and add a short changelog entry.
nora: i'd like to add a migration checklist (shared -> dedicated). where do we put it? provisioning/handbook or migration-guides?
tessa: put checklist under provisioning/handbook and add a crosslink to migration-guides/migrate-to-dedicated.md
nora: OK i'll PR that after this lands and reference guardrails.
sre-ryan: also add a short example of fallback policy ordering (tiered: same-region reserved -> cross-region reserved -> cheaper variant hosted). keep it prescriptive but not absolute.
mike: small nit: make sure the SDK snippet uses current param names; if it's an illustrative snippet, add a short note: "example; check SDK for exact signatures".
tessa: will align with SDK v0.8 and add the note. plan: push updates in ~90 mins, ping reviewers, merge after approvals + changelog. thanks all :thumbsup:
